{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
# First, ensure revenue is treated as string
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check how many QA rows there are
n_qa = len(qa_rows)
print(f"Number of QA rows found: {n_qa}")

# Check if any QA rows have status 'completed'
qa_completed = qa_rows['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)
print(f"Number of QA rows with status 'completed': {qa_completed}")

# Total completed orders in the full dataset
total_completed_full = df['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)

# Actual completed orders (excluding QA rows)
actual_completed = total_completed_full - qa_completed

# Print the result
actual_completed"}
